raw:
Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the destination/route by treating “Augusta” as a much closer location (likely Augusta, Georgia) and giving a 508.1-mile leg “via I-90,” which is inconsistent with a California-to-Maine trip and not plausible via I-90. This incorrect segment distance cascaded into wrong total miles, bottle count, and refund. (They later also assumed a $0.05 deposit without citing Wikipedia and rounded bottles instead of miles, but the first error occurred at Step 5.)
